verdict.rationale: The only power figure is a community post listing the Workstation edition at 600 W, and another post implies roughly 2.4 kW for four cards. None of the first-party product or developer docs in the pack state board power, connector requirements, or cooling guidance. missing for 10: official TDP/TGP spec, power connector type and count, PSU recommendation, first-party cooling/airflow guidance, and per-variant (Workstation vs Max-Q) power data.
